milestones.detail: Galvani Bioelectronics — Preparing for orderly shutdown. Major exit in the bioelectronic medicine space. GSK + Verily joint venture dissolving.
FDA Leadership — Makary stepped down; Diamantas named acting commissioner. Leadership change may affect device approval timelines.
Prophetic Dream Enhancement — Launched two products: Dual ($449, Q4 2026) and Phase ($1,299, Q3 2027). Consumer lucid dreaming BCI.

Motif Neurotech — FDA IDE approval for therapeutic BCI (DOT device, blueberry-sized) targeting treatment-resistant depression. ARPA-H EVIDENT program participant. Rice University spinout founded 2022.
ResMed acquires Noctrix — $360M deal for restless leg syndrome device maker (~$24M ARR). ResMed betting on sleep/neuro overlap.
INBRAIN Neuroelectronics — Completed enrollment for world's first-in-human study of graphene neural interfaces. Barcelona-based.
CorTec Brain Interchange — Accepted into FDA TAP Program. Third patient successfully implanted. First BCI worldwide designated for stroke motor rehab.
NeuCyber (China) — 7 successful human implantations with Beinao-1 semi-invasive BCI. Beijing-backed company positioning against Neuralink.
Cambridge NeuroWorks — Named "Tech for Good" winner for advancing breakthrough neurotechnology. Awarded May 8, 2026.
MintNeuro + Motif Neurotech — Partnership to advance miniature BCI therapy for mental health. Precision Neuroscience + UChicago Medicine — BCI research collaboration.
Synchron INTENT trial — FDA-permitted third clinical trial of Stentrode BCI started. SetPoint Medical enrolled first MS patients in neuroimmune modulation study.
Paradromics completes first human BCI implant — actively collecting patient data for Connexus speech BCI.
RAPID Coverage Pathway — New joint CMS + FDA initiative to accelerate patient access to "life-changing" medical devices. Over 115 devices now enrolled in FDA TAP program.
Columbia Engineering BISC — Flexible BCI chip with 65,536 electrodes unveiled. World's highest-density flexible neural interface.
ONWARD Medical — First participant enrolled in global study for blood pressure instability after spinal cord injury.
Neurolief at APA Annual Meeting (May 16–20, SF) — Showcase of Proliv®Rx FDA-approved at-home brain stimulation for MDD. KOL panel May 18. 31.7% remission rate at 16 weeks in MOOD pivotal trial.

Cala Health (9 roles incl. Director of Marketing $XXXK — HOT), Nervonik (20+ roles across R&D/Clinical/Reg — growing fast post $52.5M Series B), Science Corp (Digital Marketing $150K–$220K), Merge Labs ("Neuron Whisperer" $165K–$215K SF), LivaNova (Dir Neuromodulation $215K–$250K Austin), huMannity Medtec (Dir PM $192K–$230K Santa Clara), Synchron (Field BCI Specialist $90K–$120K Buffalo), Paradromics (VP Marketing), Beacon Biosignals (BD Manager Boston/Remote 🔥).
Zeto NeuroNotis™ — AI-enabled EEG report with human review. FDA 510(k) also secured for Zeto New Wave™ outpatient EEG.
Neurable → OEM — Shifting from own-brand smart headphones to global OEM BCI integration. Also building attention-tracking AI for Apple Vision Pro.
Bioness acquires PoNS System — Portable Neuromodulation Stimulator changes hands. Neuromodulation market consolidation continues.
NeurAxis — Expands payer coverage with four new medical policies. Neuromodulation reimbursement landscape improving.
Epineuron — Received FDA 510(k) clearance for Evala® Nerve Stimulator. Non-invasive neurostimulation for pain management.
PlatoCare — Achieved EU MDR approval for first wireless tDCS depression treatment. Major regulatory milestone for non-invasive brain stimulation.
Leadership Moves — Spark Biomedical appointed Anja Krammer as CEO. NeuWire Medical named Ramin Mousavi Executive Chairman. Control Bionics added Nicholas Opie to board.

Psilocybin, Sleep & Parkinson's — Nature: single psilocybin use causes human brain changes. Sleep chart study links sleep duration to biological aging. MYNDspan: MEG scan can classify Parkinson's non-invasively.
Paradromics — Adds third clinical site for Connexus® BCI trial at University of Michigan. Study advancing toward pivotal trial.
ABILITY Neurotech — IMDD Approval to start clinical trial for chronic implantation of brain-computer interface in ALS patients.
MagVenture / MagStim — FDA 510(k) clearance for accelerated TMS protocols, expanding flexibility for clinics and patients.
Neuropace — New FDA-approved AI application for RNS® System, designed to streamline iEEG review in PDMS.
